message: Reviewer 1 requested one P2 fix in Nginx L7 audit: ssl_handshake_timeout is invalid for HTTP nginx vhost. Verified upstream ngx_http_ssl_module + nginx ticket #2235, removed directive, documented client_header_timeout also bounds HTTP TLS handshake, retained no per-IP quotas and all streaming timeout safeguards. Fixed/pushed commit 4a7bf4e4082a4a7974e4fbbdd2605c256272ef43 on docs/security-nginx-l7-audit. Branch clean, git diff --check clean, dry merge with main clean. New frozen re-review 93f949471a2e4f61846cdedcb6c353f7 submitted Unclaimed. No production edits/reload/deploy, and candidate config still awaits isolated staging parser and explicit operator authorization.
